text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And since it's your birthday, I got you<n>this special
present!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh goodness, thank you so much,<n>Falco.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's an acrylic bead set. I know<n>you do
beadwork, so I think you'll<n>really like this!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aren't the aurora colors cute?! I bet<n>they'd look
great on you!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, "angora" colors? What kind of<n>colors are
those?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... I dunno how to say it. It's<n>like a really
shimmery rainbow, that<n>sort of... shifts in color?
Does that<n>make sense?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ahh, like big soap bubbles do?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah! That, that, that! You nailed it,<n>Acute!
